per_case_results.question:
-- External Knowledge: Full name of the driver refers to drivers.forename and drivers.surname; the most winning refers to MAX(COUNT(wins)); average point scores refers to MAX(points);
Name the driver with the most winning. Mention his nationality and what is his maximum point scores.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname, T1.nationality, MAX(T2.points) FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T2.wins >= 1 GROUP BY T1.forename, T1.surname, T1.nationality ORDER BY COUNT(T2.wins) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT 
    d."forename",
    d."surname",
    d."nationality",
    MAX(r."points") AS max_points
FROM "drivers" d
JOIN (
    SELECT "driverid"
    FROM "results"
    WHERE "position" = 1
    GROUP BY "driverid"
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
) w ON d."driverid" = w."driverid"
JOIN "results" r ON d."driverid" = r."driverid"
GROUP BY d."driverid", d."forename", d."surname", d."nationality"

per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T2.forename, T2.surname FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T1.raceid = T3.raceid WHERE q3 IS NOT NULL AND T3.year = 2008 AND T3.circuitId IN (SELECT circuitId FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit') ORDER BY CAST(SPLIT_PART(q3, ':', 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(q3, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS REAL) + CAST(SPLIT_PART(q3, '.', 2) AS REAL) / 1000 ASC LIMIT 1

per_case_results.actual_sql:

per_case_results.question:
-- External Knowledge: number of accidents refers to the number where statusid = 3; Canadian Grand Prix refers to the race of name
How many accidents did the driver who had the highest number accidents in the Canadian Grand Prix have?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.driverId) FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN status AS T3 ON T1.statusId = T3.statusId WHERE T3.statusId = 3 AND T2.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' GROUP BY T1.driverId ORDER BY COUNT(T1.driverId) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM "results" r
JOIN "races" ra ON r."raceid" = ra."raceid"
JOIN "status" s ON r."statusid" = s."statusid"
WHERE s."statusid" = 3
AND ra."name" LIKE '%Canadian Grand Prix%'
AND r."driverid" = (
    SELECT r2."driverid"
    FROM "results" r2
    JOIN "races" ra2 ON r2."raceid" = ra2."raceid"
    JOIN "status" s2 ON r2."statusid" = s2."statusid"
    WHERE s2."statusid" = 3
    AND ra2."name" LIKE '%Canadian Grand Prix%'
    GROUP BY r2."driverid"
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

per_case_results.question:

Which top 20 driver created the shortest lap time ever record in a Formula_1 race? Please give them full names.
per_case_results.expected_sql: WITH lap_times_in_seconds AS (SELECT driverId, (CASE WHEN SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) <> '' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 1) AS float) * 60 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) <> '' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS float) ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) <> '' THEN CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(time, ':', 2), '.', 2) AS float) / 1000 ELSE 0 END) AS time_in_seconds FROM lapTimes) SELECT T2.forename, T2.surname, T1.driverId FROM (SELECT driverId, MIN(time_in_seconds) AS min_time_in_seconds FROM lap_times_in_seconds GROUP BY driverId) AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId ORDER BY T1.min_time_in_seconds ASC LIMIT 20
per_case_results.actual_sql:

per_case_results.question:
-- External Knowledge: lap record means the fastest time recorded which refers to time
Please list the lap records for the circuits in Italy.
per_case_results.expected_sql: WITH fastest_lap_times AS (SELECT T1.raceId, T1.FastestLapTime, (CAST(SPLIT_PART(T1.FastestLapTime, ':', 1) AS REAL) * 60) + (CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(T1.FastestLapTime, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS REAL)) + (CAST(SPLIT_PART(T1.FastestLapTime, '.', 2) AS REAL) / 1000) AS time_in_seconds FROM results AS T1 WHERE T1.FastestLapTime IS NOT NULL) SELECT T1.FastestLapTime AS lap_record FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN circuits AS T3 ON T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId INNER JOIN (SELECT MIN(fastest_lap_times.time_in_seconds) AS min_time_in_seconds FROM fastest_lap_times INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON fastest_lap_times.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN circuits AS T3 ON T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId WHERE T3.country = 'Italy') AS T4 ON (CAST(SPLIT_PART(T1.FastestLapTime, ':', 1) AS REAL) * 60) + (CAST(SPLIT_PART(SPLIT_PART(T1.FastestLapTime, ':', 2), '.', 1) AS REAL)) + (CAST(SPLIT_PART(T1.FastestLapTime, '.', 2) AS REAL) / 1000) = T4.min_time_in_seconds LIMIT 1
per_case_results.actual_sql:

JOIN "results" "res" ON "r"."raceid" = "res"."raceid"
